title: XPeng shops its self-driving tech to automakers — Tesla found no takers
summary:
XPeng is trying to turn its self-driving and smart-cockpit systems into a licensing business, courting automakers, suppliers, and software firms well beyond its existing Volkswagen deal, according to a Reuters report.
